name: Grimtallow, the Siege-Husk
place: world boss of Torbor Downs: the Blackthorn Scar (zone blackthorn_scar, levels 7-10). Arena ~50 m radius of open, walkable, dry ground in front of the warband stockade, with room for 4 totems, 4 signal fires, 2 ballistae and a blight pool. Run by the realm event director (PLAN §5.2): announced 10 min ahead, free waystone travel while it runs.
_doc: Stream E (M2). The province WORLD BOSS. A siege-engine husk the warband grew out of blighted wood and old armour, walking on four legs of tree trunk. P1 'The March' (to 65%): a stomping cone, siege volleys raining on random players, a straight-line charge, and the War Drum — a line-of-sight blast the size of the arena: hide behind the four warband totems (each survives three drums). Two loaded ballistae on the ridge fire into it once each. P2 'The Warband' (65% to the end of its first bar): it plants itself behind a shield while cultist waves pour in; LIGHT ALL FOUR SIGNAL FIRES to call the Reeve Watch's catapults and break the shield; meanwhile it tries to blow a Rally Horn (interrupt it or another wave comes) and rains blight that leaves pools. P3, a NEW health bar 'Uprooted': ground splits that need 4 players to soak, a 5-player shield-wall stack, crater safe spots, spiralling thorn lines, and a blight pool in the middle that HEALS it if the tank lets it stand there. P4, a SECOND new bar 'Death Throes': everything faster — collapse circles following everyone, eight-way thorn lines, a donut nova, and a last interruptible Rally Horn. Soft enrage from 5 minutes, hard at 9.
party: Built for a crowd (10-60). 5 players: soaks (need 4) and the shield-wall stack (need 5) are the whole fight — all hands; doable but tight. 2-3: not intended — soak fails will wipe; the event director should not run it below ~8 players in band. M5 scaling: health and add waves scale with the players enrolled (PLAN §5.2); soak `need` = clamp(players/5, 2, 5), stack `need` = clamp(players/4, 3, 8); volley count +1 per 10 players.

onUse.say: A ballista bolt the size of a fence post slams into Grimtallow!
The second ballista fires — Grimtallow staggers!

pull: The stockade gates burst outward. Something taller than the walls walks through them.
Grimtallow's war drums shake the Scar. The warband cheers from the ridge.
TIMBER AND IRON. BLIGHT AND BONE. WE MARCH.
say.death: Grimtallow crashes down across the Scar. The war drums stop, one by one, and the warband on the ridge scatters.
say.reset: Grimtallow stamps back to the stockade. The drums settle into a slow, patient beat.

enrage.say: THE SCAR TAKES YOU ALL. NOTHING GROWS HERE BUT US.

soft.say: The blight spreads under your feet. Grimtallow grows stronger.

siege_volley.name: Siege Volley
siege_volley.say: Archers on the ridge — volley incoming!

charge.name: Battering Charge
charge.say: Grimtallow lowers its ram-head at {target} — get out of the line!

war_drum.name: War Drum
war_drum.say: THE DRUM! Get behind a totem!

rally_horn.name: Rally Horn
rally_horn.say: Grimtallow lifts its war horn — interrupt it, or the warband comes!

onInterrupt.say: The horn chokes off in a splintering honk.

actions.say: Cultists charge down from the ridge!

blight_rain.name: Blight Rain
blight_rain.say: Black rain falls — and it stays where it lands.

ground_split.name: Ground Split
ground_split.say: The ground cracks under {target} — FOUR of you stand on it to hold it shut!

telegraphs.failSay: Not enough feet on the crack — the Scar splits open under everyone!

shield_wall.name: Shield Wall
shield_wall.say: Grimtallow swings at {target} — shield wall! Five of you, stand together!

craters.name: Siege Barrage
craters.say: Catapult stones from the stockade — get into the old craters!

thorn_spiral.name: Thorn Spiral
thorn_spiral.say: Thorns spiral out from its roots!

collapse.name: Collapse
collapse.say: Its bark is falling off in slabs — keep moving!

blight_nova.name: Blight Nova
blight_nova.say: Blight bursts outward — get UNDER it!

phases.name: The Warband
phases.say: WARBAND! TO ME! HOLD THE SCAR!

onEnter.say: Grimtallow plants itself behind a wall of blight. Light all four signal fires to call the catapults!

phases.name: Uprooted
phases.say: YOU BURNED MY WARBAND'S FIRES? THEN I WILL TEAR UP THE GROUND ITSELF.

phases.name: Death Throes
phases.say: Grimtallow splits down the middle and keeps coming, burning from inside.

do.say: Four signal fires! The Reeve Watch's catapults pound Grimtallow and its blight wall shatters!
Every totem is splinters. The next drum will catch everyone!
